scope: Source/API inspection and exact pinned artifact metadata. This record does not claim native Swift, Gemma, Metal or ANE execution.

upstream.proof: Serialize handle use; cancellation from a generation callback is the documented exception.
Use the actual C signatures, JSON system content, background callback contract and explicit completion barrier.
Native callbacks borrow chunk storage for the callback duration; copy chunk/error strings before returning.
Current count is the Session position. CountTokens preprocesses the new message, including the first-turn preface when appropriate, without appending history.
Input count derives from text tokens and audio frame geometry; InputAudioEnd contributes one token.
Selects the raw-PCM or mel preprocessor from the actual model configuration and appends audio-end input.
Preprocesses each audio file and immediately resets the preprocessor; the setup counting probe leaves no buffered frames.
Raw frames use length/hop 640; mel frames use length 320/hop 160. Geometry depends on the configured sample rate and frame policy.
Builds tensor sequence dimensions from the number of raw or mel frames, with no silence-dependent branch.
Counts windows from sample lengths and padding; signal transforms preserve frame count.
Falls back to the smallest prefill runner as capacity shrinks and rejects input that cannot fit. Both artifact receipts expose a 128-token runner.
Decode checks output/context limits after a returned token batch. Reaching the context limit can finish with MaxNumTokensReached; repeated restoration of that cache does not free capacity.

Ordinary execution retains its initialized sampler across turns; a new context starts from configured sampling state. Patches 0004/0008 add checkpoint loading and reset transient sampling/priming state.
MTP uses its own verifier sampling/transient state; the checkpoint patches re-prime instead of serializing random-generator state.
A wait timeout is not a lifetime barrier. The Swift bridge retains handles and callback storage while retrying DeadlineExceeded.
A prime mask dimension greater than 10 marks context resize. Requested positive capacity must be strictly below the marker; otherwise the helper uses its smaller default multiple 256.
CPU/GPU environment creation enables the magic-number configuration helper by default.
Destructor ignores a bounded WaitUntilDone failure. Deletion alone cannot justify releasing borrowed callback data.
After its bounded wait, engine destruction resets the execution manager. The cancellation fixture retains callback storage through this operation.
Pool destruction stops scheduling and joins workers; workers process pending closures before exiting. Execution-manager destruction resets execution then callback pools.

local_extensions.bridge: The appended C count_tokens function forwards to existing Conversation::CountTokens. Conversation save/load are new APIs; they are not claimed to exist at the upstream pin.
local_extensions.counting_policy: During setup, count one app-generated 30-second mono 16 kHz WAV with the actual system preface in a fresh conversation. Per turn, query only the current token count.
local_extensions.reserve: Counted input + configured maximum output 256 + conservative padding 256. The padding covers up to 127 tokens from prefill_128, possible Session BOS accounting, and at most 4 tokens of overshoot from a cold four-step MTP batch.
local_extensions.rollover: Before submitting a turn that exceeds this reserve, remove and sync CURRENT, replace the live conversation, and announce lost prior context. A failed or interrupted new turn therefore cannot recover the retired full cache.
local_extensions.rng: Only completed-turn model context and exact history are restored. Sampler RNG is not serialized; loading creates fresh sampling/verification state from the target configuration. Subsequent stochastic draws/text need not match an uninterrupted process.
local_extensions.cancellation_qualification: Session cancellation callback storage survives both Session and Engine deletion. Callback-accessor and async-start errors terminate the isolated child process rather than mark a fake final callback or unwind possibly borrowed storage. Native cancellation remains unrun.

artifact_geometry.capacity_reason: 32003 is the observed prime mask/KV dimension. A 32768 request falls back to 32000, so 32768 is not a usable-capacity guarantee. Automatic E4B selection below 16 GiB currently caps at 8192.

review.result: Context rollover, completed-turn persistence, explicit random-generator limitation and native-validation limitations agree with the inspected implementation.
review.limitation: The setup reserve remains a source-derived conservative bound pending the two-artifact Mac qualification gate.
